pages.text: The five friends gathered in a circle in the square. They would play hide-and-seek.
They needed to choose the seeker. All five made fists.
"Rock, paper—" Ppino opened their hand first.
Only Ppino's hand was wide open. "I won!"
Leo said, "You went first." "No, we went together."
They tried again. Ppino went first again.
One by one, the four left. Ppino was alone in the square.
Grandma Bear sat beside Ppino with her hand in a fist. "If you go early, nobody can go with you."
Ppino called the four back. This time, Ppino kept the fist closed until the end, then opened it. Ppino lost.
Ppino closed their eyes and counted to ten. The four scattered to hide.
